## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix fingerprint refresh before merge because it can erase the baseline used to detect edits to tracked files.

## Changes

The pull request adds two helpers that update the integrity manifest and tests for registering new files and preserving existing entries.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints during refresh — Refreshing `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` after editing `tracked.txt` makes `verify()` return `True` because refresh replaces the stored digest with the digest of the edited file. — When refresh includes an edited tracked file, users lose the recorded baseline they need to detect the edit. — Fix: Reuse the insert-only behavior in `register_new_files()` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` with an edited tracked file.
